content:
Hi, I’m chí chěng (池骋): a proud Fuzhou native, a heartbroken Hongkonger in pieces, and a Beijinger in disguise who can never go back. Since September 2022, I’ve been learning how to be Canadian. So far, I have yet to find a place in this world where I would wholeheartedly choose to stay.
My life, when it comes down to it, is about two things: writing and connections with people. Nothing compares to the happiness I find in writing what I want to write. The time and care I put into building connections make me believe my life has meaning. These are the two things I will never compromise on, trade away, or give up.
Here you’ll find all kinds of things I’ve written, including pieces published in the media, but mostly the little things I write along the way. They are just as important, just as interesting, and just as necessary to write. Lately, I’ve grown a little weary of Chinese-language nonfiction, and I’m curious about what it would be like to write short stories in English. So I read a little, take some notes, and perhaps one day I’ll find my way into it. Until then, I’ll let that feeling flow freely.
“Life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. We fought for these ideals, we shouldn’t settle for less.”
You can read my writing in Chinese, or get in touch at chichengwrites@gmail.com.
